profile.name: Sendy Prismana N
profile.headline: Network Infrastructure Engineer
about: I'm a Network Infrastructure Engineer at RSUD Syarifah Ambami Rato Ebu, and a Computer Engineering graduate of ITS. I enjoy building full-stack web applications, experimenting with embedded systems, and exploring practical machine learning.
I like turning real-world problems into working software, from network systems to scraping, dashboards, and Arduino simulations, and learning the tools along the way.

research.narrative: I care about building working systems end to end, whether that is a web app with a real backend, a simulated embedded circuit, or a small ML experiment, and learning by shipping.
